topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I've been turnin' the soil late into the night, the stars high above watchin' over us. I can't help but think on them flowers left by the barn door. No note, nothin' to say who or why. It's got me worried, like the thick fog that rolls in just before the rains, the kind that can either fill our wells or drown our hopes. I've been feverishly plantin’ and prayin’ to the good saints, hopin’ the seeds I’ve sown might bring forth more than just thorns. I need to know, though, if there's a hand reachin' out or just somethin' to keep the mind from the dark. The harvest is comin’, and I can’t afford to guess wrong.
